limitations: victim_alone (and reproduction, which is identical since reduced_sequence is empty) is a REAL measured count: od-fixture's N1 case was actually run alone 20 times via plain Maven on 2026-10-09 (eval/tools/run_real_reps.sh), not hand-picked.
